**No, keep `is.waiwai.dictation`.** Changing it resets every user's Accessibility grant, so they'd have to re-approve the app. Sparkle updates also depend on the bundle ID matching the installed app.

For the OpenRamble name, change only the display name (`CFBundleDisplayName` and `CFBundleName`). Users see "OpenRamble" and nothing breaks.

If you still want the identifier changed, that overrides a permanent invariant. Tell me and I'll update the rules and release docs first. I haven't checked whether any builds are already installed with grants, which would decide how much this costs.
